key_insight: KampoBench shifts LLM evaluation from memorizing Kampo facts to judging whether a model can apply them appropriately in patient-specific consultations.
clinical_relevance: For traditional medicine use in real-world care, the study suggests consultation-style assessment is more informative than exam-style accuracy alone.
method: Built 74 Japanese Kampo consultation scenarios with 310 rubric criteria
LLM-generated drafts were revised by board-certified Kampo physicians
Ten current models from three vendors were scored, with each response graded by models from all vendors
evidence_signal: The top model scored 74.8–86.3% across graders, while physician-revised reference answers scored 87.9–92.4%; grader rankings were highly consistent (Spearman’s rho 0.952–0.976).
watch_item: Results depend on grader choice and vendor-specific leniency, so scores should be interpreted as benchmark performance rather than direct evidence of clinical safety or patient benefit.
paper_title: From examinations to consultations: a physician-reviewed Japanese benchmark for large language models in traditional Kampo medicine
